publication_basis.pitfall_protocol: 30 traps along a 150-m transect at 5-m intervals; 15 ethylene-glycol and 15 Turquin solution in alternating positions
publication_basis.beating_protocol: 10 samples from each of the three most common native tree species

event_semantics.pitfall_fieldNumber_parse: ETHY-Snn, TURQ-Snn or TUR-Snn with nn in 1..30; raw missing/malformed fieldNumber remains an observed pitfall event but is not assigned a trap position

audit_questions: How many pitfall Event rows exist in each publication-defined core site-phase?
How many distinct parseable pitfall positions 1..30 are represented, and how many pitfall rows have missing/malformed position labels?
Are parseable ETHY and TUR/TURQ labels consistent with an alternating odd/even trap layout?
How much pitfall effort is retained per site-phase and per island-phase relative to the nominal 30 traps per site?
Does the total excess above the publication's 4929 Event count equal the number of beating Event rows above 30 per site-phase?
Can a pitfall-only repeated panel be defined without choosing among extra beating tree-species samples?

pitfall_only_core_can_advance_to_next_ga: all 30 conceptual lineages have pitfall Event coverage in all three phases
all seven core islands remain represented in all three phases
no site-phase has more than 30 distinct parseable trap positions
response-independent effort summaries are sufficient to freeze a surveyed-zero quality rule before occurrence access

anti_selection: do not choose a pitfall effort threshold based on taxon occurrence or source-loss effects
do not use the 4929 total to delete pitfall events
do not inspect Occurrence extension rows or taxon identities
do not repair malformed fieldNumber labels using occurrence content
beating events are excluded from the proposed primary method for comparability, not because their ecological outcomes are known
